activity.notes: Ramón Castilla's periods as Peruvian head of state were historically discontinuous. ATLAS records each period separately and preserves the office title appropriate to this specific interval.

sources.title: Ramón Castilla — Congreso de la República del Perú
sources.citation_text: The Peruvian Congress chronology lists Ramón Castilla's five periods as head of state: 17 Feb–11 Dec 1844, 20 Apr 1845–20 Apr 1851, 5 Jan 1855–24 Oct 1858, 24 Oct 1858–24 Oct 1862, and 3–9 Apr 1863.

sources.title: Decreto de 1844 — Congreso de la República del Perú
sources.citation_text: The contemporary decree identifies Castilla as president of the provisional Supreme Government Junta created in the south, supporting a distinct 1844 governing role.
